title: The turbo C ABI
text: libturbo exposes one C ABI, the turbo_ functions, over every accelerator. Providers are plugins loaded with dlopen that implement a vtable; the runtime, the bundle loader and the tokenizer are shared.

title: Providers
text: The providers are cuda (ONNX Runtime's CUDA execution provider), openvino (Intel GPUs and CPUs), ggml (llama.cpp for GGUF generation and embeddings), hailo (HailoRT on the Hailo-8) and metal (Metal Shading Language kernels on Apple GPUs).

title: Hailo provider
text: The hailo provider runs a compiled HEF on the Hailo-8 through HailoRT. The embedding tables live beside the HEF in the bundle, and the host applies them before the network runs on the accelerator.

title: Matched benchmarks
text: A provider's speed is checked against a reference program that drives the vendor runtime directly on the same tokens. turbo-bench compare reports libturbo as a fraction of native per cell; SUPPORTED means every cell reaches 0.95 of native.

title: Hailo benchmark
text: For hailo the reference is hailortcli benchmark on the HEF, HailoRT's own tool; its streaming frames per second are the rows per second. On the Hailo-8 Pi the comparison is 1.00x and the verdict is SUPPORTED.

title: Metal provider
text: The metal provider compiles its kernels from source at load and runs the linear layers on the simdgroup matrix units of Apple GPU family 7 and later. On an M2 it embeds 622 vectors per second at batch 32 and 32 tokens.

title: Native tokenizer
text: The core tokenizer is a native WordPiece implementation over generated Unicode tables. It matches the Hugging Face tokenizer token for token on the parity corpus and is about three times faster, and it removed sixty crates from the dependency tree.

title: Bundles
text: A bundle is a directory with a manifest, the model artifact (ONNX, GGUF, safetensors or HEF) and the tokenizer. turbo-bundle import writes one from a Hugging Face checkout and records the pooling, normalization and sequence limits the model was trained with.

title: Inferstream
text: Inferstream is the inference server: the KServe Open Inference Protocol v2 over gRPC and REST, OpenAI-shaped routes for embeddings, rerank, classify and chat, and a repository extension that loads and unloads bundles while the server runs.

title: Session buckets
text: Sessions have a fixed batch and sequence length. The server keeps a pool per bucket and picks the smallest bucket that fits a request; a text longer than the longest bucket is rejected unless the request asks for truncation.

title: OpenVINO on the B70
text: On the Intel Battlemage B70 the openvino provider runs at 1.15x to 1.55x of the OpenVINO C++ reference because it keeps the hidden state on the device and pools there, while the plain program copies it back to the host.

title: Failing loudly
text: Every option is honored exactly or rejected with a status and the index of the field at fault. Nothing is truncated, defaulted or retried behind the caller's back, and a model that fails to load fails the server rather than leaving it half ready.
